feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. (1) Iteration 6 (seven 16 mm sensors, 1 cm pitch, 4 cm lead, x/0.015 weights, kp 3.0, kd 0.1) is the best current reference: s-bend 0.155, oval 0.11, slalom 0.1075, one line loss per run, score 51.11 (entityR2B). The controller works at this layout. (2) Iterations 2, 3 and 5 all collapsed s-bend progress to 0.04. Iteration 3 changed only the lead (2 cm), so leads below 4 cm are harmful on their own. Iteration 5 kept the 4 cm lead but used 2 cm pitch, so pitch is the likely cause of its collapse. (3) Footprint has been neutral at 1.5 cm pitch (iterations 1 and 4, both 0.155 s-bend), so 12 mm versus 16 mm is not yet known to matter at 1 cm pitch. (4) Iteration 2 at plus or minus 6 cm removed line losses but still left the track at max_error about 0.06 m, so line losses are not the only exit cause. (5) rms_error stayed near 0.03 and steering_oscillation between 0.065 and 0.155 in every iteration, so the offset looks like a motor-mismatch term rather than geometry. Next race: if s-bend progress stays at or above 0.15 and line losses are at or below 1, footprint is neutral at 1 cm pitch too. Keep 12 mm, and the next geometry test is a narrower footprint (0.008 m) to see whether the outer sensors are over-weighted. If s-bend progress falls below 0.11, the 16 mm footprint was needed, so restore 0.016 m. If progress is unchanged and line losses stay at 1, geometry is no longer the lever, and the line_loss setting or gains are the next tests.
